steps.en: Prepare the binary and the platform's native webview requirements
steps.zh: 准备二进制及平台原生网页引擎依赖

steps.en: Write a page that logs its result and closes when done
steps.zh: 编写输出结果后主动关闭的页面

steps.en: Launch webframe with your page's file path
steps.zh: 把页面路径交给 webframe 启动

steps.en: Run the page in a hidden system webview and forward console output
steps.zh: 在隐藏系统网页视图中执行并转发控制台输出

steps.en: Terminate the event loop on page close and return to the shell
steps.zh: 收到页面关闭消息后结束循环，返回终端

value.en: A browser-only page behaves like a terminal program without a browser automation suite
value.zh: 仅浏览器可运行的页面变成终端程序，无需浏览器自动化套件
